guide.setup: Align the knee joints with the machine pivot and place the shin pad just above the ankles.
guide.execution: Straighten the knees until the legs are nearly locked, squeeze the quadriceps, then lower under control.
guide.cues: Keep the hips down. Move smoothly. Use a pain-free range.
guide.mistakes: Kicking the weight up; lifting the hips; locking out aggressively; using a painful range.
